title: Bybit Expands Beyond Crypto as CEO Outlines Next Phase of Financial Platform
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Dubai, United Arab Emirates, October 13th, 2026] Bybit Co-founder and CEO Ben Zhou has outlined the latest stage of the company’s expansion from a crypto exchange into The New Financial Platform, highlighting new products and collaborations across traditional and digital markets.
